items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 24 at 11:58AM PDT until October 26 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 6 to 11 ft at 9 to 11 seconds and south winds 10 to
20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Sunday to 11 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
